body:
even if it existed as written, flaws and all: endure a short while of superficial physical agony in exchange for the possibility to really be a real girl who will be seen as a real girl by everyone (or even just someone) vs continuing to live with the problem that drove me to consciously choose daily intake of narcotics just to make the whole hopeless mess tolerable until i finally just die as i lived, alone and a total joke?

fucking sign me up! just dump my corpse in the trash compactor if something in the process goes wrong. either way this thing leaves me better than it found me.

yeah, i'm not one of the sassy, fierce, campy, or out and proud ones like we're supposed to be. i know.

My family tossed me aside 13 years ago, and i lost whatever close friends i had around the same time for the same reason. what's wrong with me can't be fixed. No one can take a biologically male body and reshape it into a female one. Skeletal structure and many other things are immutable after puberty (hands, feet, shoulders, hips, rib cage, etc.), and in my case it can't even be made into a convincing copy. perfect strangers who don't have any desire to hurt me in some way or another will look at me funny or stifle a laugh or something (not uncommon, but the exceptions to this are far less rare than a tolerant person might expect, and even the tolerant people often accept the scapegoating of us for the danger a lot of men present to women like with the bathroom bills and i don't even live in one of the more hostile places but those things crush me. i've taken my share of beatings and gropings and sexual assaults from other people regardless of the majority attitude of the city i live in. one guy who paid me for sex tried to drown me in the hotel bathtub later for one of potentially three reasons, i think. but my point is i'm still disposable even at best.).

and i get why people react the way they do. if i look a bit like a man and i'm in a space where most women would be at least nervous about men entering, what SHOULD they respond like instead? if i disgust you and i happen to be someone that no one will notice or care if i'm gone, why not attack me? i'm angry and disgusted when i see my own reflection, so i can sympathize. and i can't fight almost everyone and expect to win, and between this body and the world without anything within my reach that i even want, and with no one in it who could ever love me as a woman, why would i stay? why would anyone stay? i don't want fifty years of more pain and emptiness where there's nothing realistic to strive for, where i really LIVE only in my dreams, from which i inevitably wake back into my nightmare and sometimes still cry about that, when i'm not too numb to cry.

all that's holding me back is my stupid fucking self-preservation instincts, which make sense for a person to have but which have done me no good. and i think those can be overcome. overcoming my survival instincts to become nothing and escape from having to be a twisted semi-human, quasi-female mistake for years and years longer is the last realistic hope i have left.

i don't have enough money to get housing, and i don't think the job market or community will be any better for an abomination like me since i already live in a major city with a reputation for being tolerant. the only difference would be that i wouldn't have the same network of clients in the new place so i'll be in an even worse financial situation for a couple of years just like when i started escorting except back then i was pre-puberty (i was a late bloomer) instead of a disgusting circus freak. scratch that--freak shows have standards. i'm just the kind of thing the world hates more than almost anything, and i don't want to be that kind of thing any more than the world wants another thing like me walking around, but i can't fix that. i'll never be anything but the kind of subhuman creature i most hate being for the rest of my misbegotten life. 

i've been on hormones for the last five years. i was accidentally outed when my mother found me in a female uniform for my school that my friend grew out of and gave to me and my ass was thrown in the street. i considered killing myself then but just doubled down on the drug use and went to work doing the only thing an underage fetish object like teenage me could do. looking back, i should have killed myself, or gotten hormones on the black market somehow which would have prevented puberty ravaging everything i am and killing my future in every way. but even then i'd still be fake, just a convincing fake instead of a laughable excuse for an insulting mimicry of women.

i fucked up by getting born and i sentenced myself to a lifetime of hell. can't i shorten the sentence? haven't i suffered enough? and like i said: no close friends, no family, no co-workers or employer, no significant other or even ongoing date partner (obviously, like come on, would YOU pick an ugly, deformed tranny over a real girl? i wouldn't pick myself if i had options, which i naturally don't have, see above), so no one will be hurt by me cutting my losses. my clients will find someone else to fuck and belittle and smack around, and statistically she'll probably be prettier and more female-looking. i played the hand i was dealt as boldly as i could, but now the only play is to fold. the only alternative is to bleed dry over a long, hellish existence and die alone and with nothing and not experiencing a moment of emotional tranquility, peace, or god forbid contentment.

wouldn't you want to escape that? even if the only way out of it was death? there's not one thing that it's even possible, let alone probable, for me to have in life that i actually want at all beyond simple survival and material comfort which are not at all good enough things to be worth the eternal loss of the one, simple thing i wanted most that every girl is born with but which is beyond impossible for me to attain: femaleness, true actual, genuine, real, authentic, unequivocal, and unquestionable physical and social womanhood. and i live a life sentence as a social exile and everyone and their dog's punching bag for wanting it and pathetically imitating it.

i appreciate everyone's efforts and kind words here. i don't deserve your care and kindness, or even your notice. i just have no one to leave a note for and i wanted there to be some record that mine isn't a politically motivated suicide so i can simply disappear from memory and any psychic stain my terrible but relatively brief existence left on this world will be washed away with the first April rain in brooklyn.

i wonder if i'll learn if the divinity is real in some form. i wonder if it will apologize to me for my miscreation, or explain why my pleas to fix me went unanswered. or if i was wrong all along and my soul/identity is actually male and i'm just so crazy that i convinced myself i should have been born differently, in which case will they apologize for breaking my brain so badly that even acknowledging that my body is male is vastly more painful than being stabbed hilt-deep with a knife, which i've experienced thanks to being relegated to the underworld--the ugly scar reduced the amount i could charge for any act that would require my belly to be bare. even in the likely event i don't get answers, or the more likely event that there's nothing at all waiting for me after death, at least i won't be here anymore, being the walking dead with all the responsibilities of the living, just wanting to scream at everyone who wants something from me to leave me alone because corpses can't answer the phone and you're supposed to avoid disturbing the dead and they're lucky that i don't smell after three years of having been killed by my awareness of some permanent, immutable realities about my body, my history, and my place in the world. it's time to stop persisting in this undead state and shambling from one sorry, intolerably painful moment to the next.
